about: Embered Zombie (emberedZombie), a new unit from the user's sheets (2026-11-12, Attachments/Monsters/Embered Zombie: Idle, Walk, ATT, Fall, 64 frames 8 x 8 and 36 frames 6 x 6 each; the Fall's 64 in Fall/UpscaledTest). The user: "is there any way you can make a hit and fall from this fall video ? add the whole new unit as a type D + enemy", "can you make this one closer to 3 resolutions ? Alta Media e Leve ? just less frames for alta": Alta = the 64-frame sheets at their own size; Media = the same 64 frames at ~916 px (quality_copies.py); Leve = the user's 36-frame sheets at ~610 px. Every frame and its timing as drawn, alpha as drawn. Walk and attack are drawn facing left: mirrored to face right, the walk left also as drawn; idle and fall face the camera. Each clip's figure is measured on its own and stands figureUnits tall.
